mapper.sql: select c.schedule_id, c.target_id, min(c.credential_id) as credential_id, max(st.operation_time) as checkin_time from competition_scene_subject_operation_state st inner join competition_scene_credential c on c.credential_id = st.credential_id and c.del_flag = '0' where st.deleted = 0 and st.scope_type = 'SCHEDULE' and st.operation_type = 'REPORT' and st.operation_status = 'DONE' and c.schedule_id is not null and c.target_id is not null and st.scope_ref_id = c.schedule_id group by c.schedule_id, c.target_id

select schedule_id, target_id, min(credential_id) as credential_id from competition_scene_credential where del_flag = '0' and schedule_id is not null and target_id is not null group by schedule_id, target_id

select s.schedule_id, s.schedule_name, s.competition_series_id, s.competition_name, s.competition_track_id, s.competition_track_name, s.second_level_code, s.second_level_name, s.contest_start_time as competition_start_time, s.contest_end_time as competition_end_time, s.report_start_time as checkin_start_time, s.report_end_time as checkin_end_time, s.report_location as checkin_location, concat_ws(' / ', s.contest_location, s.contest_room) as competition_location, count(distinct t.target_id) as total_person_count, count(distinct signed.target_id) as signed_person_count, count(distinct t.target_id) - count(distinct signed.target_id) as unsigned_person_count, if(count(distinct t.target_id) = 0, 0, round(count(distinct signed.target_id) * 100 / count(distinct t.target_id), 2)) as checkin_rate, count(distinct t.target_id) as member_total_count, count(distinct signed.target_id) as member_signed_count, count(distinct coalesce(nullif(t.team_code, ''), concat('NO_TEAM:', t.target_id))) as team_total_count, max(signed.checkin_time) as last_checkin_time, s.status as schedule_status from competition_scene_schedule s left join competition_series_info cs on cs.competition_series_id = s.competition_series_id and cs.del_flag = '0' inner join competition_scene_schedule_target t on t.schedule_id = s.schedule_id left join (
) signed on signed.schedule_id = t.schedule_id and signed.target_id = t.target_id where group by s.schedule_id, s.schedule_name, s.competition_series_id, s.competition_name, s.competition_track_id, s.competition_track_name, s.second_level_code, s.second_level_name, s.contest_start_time, s.contest_end_time, s.report_start_time, s.report_end_time, s.report_location, s.contest_location, s.contest_room, s.status

select a.*, case when a.total_person_count = 0 or a.signed_person_count = 0 then 'NOT_STARTED' when a.signed_person_count = a.total_person_count then 'COMPLETED' else 'PARTIAL' end as checkin_status, case when a.unsigned_person_count > 0 and a.competition_start_time <= now() then 'RED' when a.unsigned_person_count > 0 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) <= 10 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) >= 0 then 'ORANGE' when a.checkin_rate < 80 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) <= 30 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) >= 0 then 'YELLOW' else 'NORMAL' end as warning_level, case when a.unsigned_person_count > 0 and a.competition_start_time <= now() then concat('比赛已开始，仍有', a.unsigned_person_count, '人未签到') when a.unsigned_person_count > 0 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) <= 10 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) >= 0 then concat('距离比赛开始不足10分钟，仍有', a.unsigned_person_count, '人未签到') when a.checkin_rate < 80 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) <= 30 and timestampdiff(minute, now(), a.competition_start_time) >= 0 then '距离比赛开始不足30分钟，签到率低于80%' else '' end as warning_message from (
) a
mapper.select:
select coalesce(sum(r.total_person_count), 0) as total_person_count, coalesce(sum(r.signed_person_count), 0) as signed_person_count, coalesce(sum(r.unsigned_person_count), 0) as unsigned_person_count, if(coalesce(sum(r.total_person_count), 0) = 0, 0, round(sum(r.signed_person_count) * 100 / sum(r.total_person_count), 2)) as checkin_rate, count(r.schedule_id) as schedule_count, sum(case when r.warning_level != 'NORMAL' then 1 else 0 end) as warning_schedule_count, max(r.last_checkin_time) as last_checkin_time from (
) r

select r.schedule_id, r.schedule_name, r.total_person_count, r.signed_person_count, r.unsigned_person_count, r.checkin_rate, r.competition_start_time from (
) r where r.total_person_count > 0 order by r.checkin_rate asc, abs(timestampdiff(minute, now(), r.competition_start_time)) asc, r.competition_start_time asc limit 10

select r.competition_start_time, count(r.schedule_id) as schedule_count, coalesce(sum(r.total_person_count), 0) as total_person_count, coalesce(sum(r.signed_person_count), 0) as signed_person_count, coalesce(sum(r.unsigned_person_count), 0) as unsigned_person_count, if(coalesce(sum(r.total_person_count), 0) = 0, 0, round(sum(r.signed_person_count) * 100 / sum(r.total_person_count), 2)) as checkin_rate from (
) r group by r.competition_start_time order by r.competition_start_time asc

select * from (
) r order by case r.warning_level when 'RED' then 1 when 'ORANGE' then 2 when 'YELLOW' then 3 else 4 end, r.competition_start_time asc, r.schedule_id desc

select g.team_code, g.team_name, g.total_person_count, g.signed_person_count, g.total_person_count - g.signed_person_count as unsigned_person_count, if(g.total_person_count = 0, 0, round(g.signed_person_count * 100 / g.total_person_count, 2)) as checkin_rate, case when g.total_person_count > 0 and g.signed_person_count = g.total_person_count then 'COMPLETED' when g.signed_person_count > 0 then 'PARTIAL' else 'NOT_STARTED' end as team_status from ( select coalesce(nullif(t.team_code, ''), concat('NO_TEAM:', t.target_id)) as team_code, coalesce(nullif(t.team_name, ''), '未分组') as team_name, count(distinct t.target_id) as total_person_count, count(distinct signed.target_id) as signed_person_count from competition_scene_schedule_target t left join (
) signed on signed.schedule_id = t.schedule_id and signed.target_id = t.target_id where t.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and t.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0' and t.match_status = 'MATCHED' and t.competition_role_name in ('队员', 'MEMBER', '选手', 'PLAYER') group by coalesce(nullif(t.team_code, ''), concat('NO_TEAM:', t.target_id)), coalesce(nullif(t.team_name, ''), '未分组') ) g order by g.team_name asc, g.team_code asc
